title: Test-function reduction for bounded sequences: convergence against C¹_c(Ω) implies convergence against L¹(Ω) (density of C_c^∞(Ω) in L¹(Ω), parent step (3.0))
statement: Let k ∈ ℕ, let Ω ⊆ ℝ^k (ℝ^k = Eucl k) be open, B ∈ ℝ, and let f_j : ℝ^k → ℝ (j ∈ ℕ) and f₀ : ℝ^k → ℝ be a.e.-strongly measurable for Lebesgue measure restricted to Ω, with |f_j(w)| ≤ B and |f₀(w)| ≤ B for all j and all w ∈ Ω. Suppose that ∫_Ω φ(w)·f_j(w) dw → ∫_Ω φ(w)·f₀(w) dw as j → ∞ for every φ : ℝ^k → ℝ of class C¹ (ContDiff ℝ 1) with compact support and tsupport φ ⊆ Ω. Then ∫_Ω η(w)·f_j(w) dw → ∫_Ω η(w)·f₀(w) dw as j → ∞ for every η : ℝ^k → ℝ that is Lebesgue-integrable on Ω (dw = Lebesgue measure, volume).
lean_statement: ∀ (k : ℕ) (Ω : Set (Eucl k)) (B : ℝ) (f : ℕ → Eucl k → ℝ) (f₀ : Eucl k → ℝ), IsOpen Ω → (∀ j, AEStronglyMeasurable (f j) ((volume : Measure (Eucl k)).restrict Ω)) → AEStronglyMeasurable f₀ ((volume : Measure (Eucl k)).restrict Ω) → (∀ j, ∀ w ∈ Ω, |f j w| ≤ B) → (∀ w ∈ Ω, |f₀ w| ≤ B) → (∀ φ : Eucl k → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ Ω → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ w in Ω, φ w * f j w ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl k))) atTop (𝓝 (∫ w in Ω, φ w * f₀ w ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl k))))) → ∀ η : Eucl k → ℝ, IntegrableOn η Ω (volume : Measure (Eucl k)) → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ w in Ω, η w * f j w ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl k))) atTop (𝓝 (∫ w in Ω, η w * f₀ w ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl k))))
